slides.title: Find the unit setting
slides.html: Tap Inbox at the bottom left, then Set your unit to watch its area › at the end of its list. It opens the ORBAT your admins published, or the built-in rifle company until they do.

slides.title: Go into your platoon
slides.html: Tap › at the right of your platoon's row to go into it. Tapping the row itself picks that unit.

slides.title: Tap your squad or platoon
slides.html: Tap your squad, or the platoon's card at the top if you lead the platoon, here 1J.

slides.title: See what your unit reports
slides.html: The Inbox now watches 1J's area and, as you lead 1J, counts its squads' reports under Reported by your unit. Tap Done.

slides.title: See your unit in Markers
slides.html: Tap Markers on the thumb bar and pick Friendly. The Unit field above Cancel now reads your unit, here 1J, so the friendly marks you place belong to it unless you pick another unit.

slides.title: Change it later
slides.html: To change your unit later, tap ≡, scroll the tools to OpenDefence Main and tap your unit under My unit, here 1J. The last row of the list that opens, No unit, clears it.
